goofy.js: Minimize tab flicker when test is finished. When a test is finished and the tab is removed, tabbar would automatically select the next tab available, and the goofy backend would set visible on the first active test, which cause a small flicker that shows a wrong tab selected. Fix this by selecting the first tab in front end after a test is finished. BUG=b:64963909 TEST=make test TEST=manually on DUT. Change-Id: I406d16015475896b47aeb76f286b6479a320e186 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/625541 Commit-Ready: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Tested-by: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org>

goofy: Preserve tab ordering in parallel test group. Currently for parallel test group with multiple UI, the order for which the tab appearing is not deterministic, since it's the order that those tests call test_ui.UI(). Send a INIT_TEST_UI before starting invocation if the test have UI, to make sure that the test UI are initialized in order, so it would be same as the order in test list. Also add some comment on why we still need INIT_TEST_UI in test_ui.UI(). BUG=b:64963909 TEST=make test TEST=manually on DUT. Change-Id: Ia90c12eec4b2875d6d852fa79db52761abb0a12b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/625542 Commit-Ready: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Tested-by: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org>

cloud_trace: Env variable for context Use an environment variable CLOUD_TRACE_CONTEXT to do the same thing that the X-Cloud-Trace-Context header does for App Engine: propagate the trace-id and parent-span-id across boundaries. In this case, setting the environment variable will let the subprocesses create subspans within the same trace. BUG=chromium:751231 TEST=Added unit tests. Change-Id: I0c8046ffdc733336146f2de551decae412a58780 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/618289 Commit-Ready: Paul Hobbs <phobbs@google.com> Tested-by: Paul Hobbs <phobbs@google.com> Reviewed-by: Paul Hobbs <phobbs@google.com>

login: shutdown the android container more quickly When the android container is booted during the login screen, it has no user state. This allows us to kill it in a "quick and dirty" fashion when the it is determined that the user has opted out of ARC. The benefit of doing this is that it reduced the load on the system during a performance critical time (tab restore). BUG=b:62463418 TEST=Verified that new log message was seen. Observed the time to shutdown the Android container halfed (0.88s to 0.43s). Ran chromeos-login unit tests on caroline. Change-Id: I5e0774f783954e59c532a964a243a66d279d14e6 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/627638 Commit-Ready: Christopher Morin <cmtm@google.com> Tested-by: Christopher Morin <cmtm@google.com> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org>

factory_server: Fix failure if URL not set or if server is not Umpire. When server URL is not set, shopfloor.get_server_url() returns None instead of empty string, so we have to convert it before sending it to labels. Also, in Goofy update module, the proxy object may come from xmlrpclib.ServerProxy which does not have __nonzero__ so we should check the object by comparing to 'is None' instead of reading its boolean state. BUG=b:64424287 TEST=manually deployed a factory_server and run sync_factory_server without setting factory_server_url. Change-Id: I14b30a87cbdc06b834d77e206d3442d462b89d22 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/630339 Commit-Ready: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Youcheng Syu <youcheng@chromium.org>

Dome: check if user's using Chrome/Chromium Using any browser other than Chrome/Chromium to visit Dome might encounter issues (e.g., upload timeout might be too short). Since Dome is only for Googlers and partners, comparing to make it compatible with all browsers, we could just let it check if user is using Chrome/Chromium. This CL shows a warning message to those who visits Dome with any other browser. BUG=b:62990741 TEST=manually(Chrome, Chromium, Firefox) Change-Id: Ib11708d22bd221a1d6533ee4bcd82d5fb4947fd1 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/627949 Commit-Ready: Chih-Wei Ning <cwning@google.com> Tested-by: Chih-Wei Ning <cwning@google.com> Reviewed-by: Mao Huang <littlecvr@chromium.org>
